project.name: Real Estate Deal Evaluator
project.description: Real Estate Deal Evaluator is a browser-based, no-login property investment analysis tool that enables agents, investors, lenders, and brokers to evaluate, compare, and present real estate deals instantly using institutional-grade financial metrics. The platform calculates: ROI IRR Cap rate Cash flow Cash-on-cash return DSCR Equity multiple Breakeven year 10-year projections It also generates client-ready reports and side-by-side property comparisons within seconds. The goal is to become the fastest and most trusted deal evaluation tool for real estate professionals.

epics.title: Property Input System
epics.description: The Property Input System allows users to enter basic property details including address, purchase price, property type, and various income and expense metrics. This feature is essential as it forms the foundation for all calculations and projections.

epics.title: Calculation Engine
epics.description: The Calculation Engine is responsible for computing essential real estate investment metrics such as Cap Rate, Cash-on-Cash Return, and Internal Rate of Return (IRR).

epics.title: 10-Year Financial Projection
epics.description: This feature generates detailed 10-year financial projections encompassing rental income growth and property appreciation.

features.title: Property Info Input
features.description: Allows users to input essential property information such as address and purchase price.
features.acceptance_criteria: ["Users can input property address without errors.","Users can input purchase price as a numeric value without errors.","The input form validates data in real-time."]

features.title: Financing Input
features.description: Enables users to input financing details such as loan amount and interest rate.
features.acceptance_criteria: ["Users can input loan amount without errors.","Users can input interest rate as a numeric value without errors.","The input form validates financing data."]

features.title: Expense Input
features.description: Captures various expenses related to the property such as property tax and maintenance.
features.acceptance_criteria: ["Users can input property tax without errors.","Users can input maintenance costs as a numeric value without errors.","The input form validates expense data."]

features.title: Cap Rate Calculation
features.description: Calculates the Capitalization Rate based on income and expenses.
features.acceptance_criteria: ["Cap Rate calculation returns accurate results based on input values.","Calculation is performed in under 500ms.","Results are displayed clearly on the user interface."]

features.title: IRR Calculation
features.description: Calculates the Internal Rate of Return for the property investment.
features.acceptance_criteria: ["IRR calculation returns accurate results.","Calculation is performed in under 500ms.","Results are displayed clearly on the user interface."]

features.title: Cash Flow Analysis
features.description: Analyzes the cash flows for the investment based on input metrics.
features.acceptance_criteria: ["Cash Flow analysis returns accurate results.","Analysis is performed in under 500ms.","Results are displayed clearly on the user interface."]

features.title: Annual Projection Generation
features.description: Generates annual projections for the next 10 years based on user inputs.
features.acceptance_criteria: ["Projections are generated in less than 500ms after inputs are submitted.","Projections accurately reflect user-defined parameters.","All projections are stored in the database."]

features.title: Visualization of Financial Metrics
features.description: Visualizes key financial metrics over the projection period using graphs and charts.
features.acceptance_criteria: ["Visuals accurately represent the financial metrics over time.","Users can interact with the visualizations.","Visualizations load within 500ms."]

features.title: Scenario Comparison Charts
features.description: Compares different scenarios and displays results graphically for user analysis.
features.acceptance_criteria: ["Comparison charts accurately represent different scenarios.","Users can switch between scenarios easily.","Charts load within 500ms."]
